explication: Lanyard ingests Discord Gateway events, maintains per-user live presence and KV state, and exposes it through REST and WebSocket subscriptions; its Discord bot also manages KV commands. Redis backs KV and cross-node presence synchronization, while Prometheus metrics expose service behavior. The principal runtime stages and documented API, socket, KV, bot, and monitoring branches are represented. Some implementations (notably metrics export, route handlers, and bot commands) were not excerpted, so uncertain links are omitted.
